scope: Bounded primary-source research on governed resource discovery, provenance, takeover context, delegation, independent review, and human attention for the CourtWork workspace-governance map.

search_accounting.count_definition: sources_reviewed is the sum of numResults requested across search calls, not the count of sources accepted after validation.

searches.workstream: organizational roles, separation of duties, least privilege, audit
searches.query: Official NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security control text for separation of duties AC-5, least privilege AC-6, and audit record generation AU-12 in multi-actor systems

searches.workstream: provenance, versions, actors and derived resources
searches.query: Official W3C PROV-DM and PROV-O specifications defining provenance relations between entities, activities, agents, revisions, derivation, use, generation, and attribution

searches.workstream: scoped workspace roots, resource discovery and exact reads
searches.query: Official Model Context Protocol specification for filesystem roots, resource discovery and read semantics, clarifying the difference between discoverability and authorization

searches.workstream: parallel task decomposition, context isolation, review and coordination cost
searches.query: Primary research or first-party engineering report on multi-agent software work decomposition, isolated context budgets, independent review, and failure modes such as duplicate work or coordination overhead

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.quality: Primary normative specification from W3C; stable vocabulary source, although old enough that it is not evidence of current CourtWork implementation.
observed: Defines provenance concepts for entities, activities, agents, time, derivation, responsibility, and collections.
Includes relations for usage, generation, derivation, attribution, association, and delegation.
sources.application_inference: Use its terms as a possible vocabulary for versioned source lineage; do not infer access control, factual correctness, formal acceptance, or a need to store RDF.
limits: A data model does not define CourtWork authorization or domain acceptance.
This source verifies a registered vocabulary candidate; it does not select a provenance platform.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.2.0 OSCAL control catalog
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.source_type: Official security and privacy control catalog (OSCAL JSON)
sources.quality: Primary official control catalog maintained under NIST's US government repository; source is authoritative for its own controls, not a neutral agent-workflow study.
observed: Catalog labels AC-5 as Separation of Duties and AC-6 as Least Privilege; the catalog includes audit and accountability controls.
The NIST publication describes controls as customizable within an organization-wide risk-management process.
sources.application_inference: Use the separation between duties, permissions, and audit as a checklist when defining role/assignment contracts; do not claim CourtWork compliance, copy the control catalog, or treat it as an agent-organization design.
limits: A security control catalog is not evidence that dividing LLM agents improves software or reduces human effort.
The raw URL follows the official repository's main branch; the retrieved document's version and last-modified metadata are recorded above.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Roots
sources.quality: Primary protocol specification; directly describes roots discovery and security considerations.
observed: Roots describe filesystem boundaries and may change with notifications.
Clients are instructed to expose only appropriately permissioned roots, validate root URIs, and implement access controls; consent is recommended.
Servers should handle roots becoming unavailable and respect boundaries.
sources.application_inference: An explicit root can scope discovery, but it is not by itself a full file inventory or a persistent per-object read grant.
limits: The protocol leaves the user-interface model open.
A root listing alone does not prove complete enumeration of every file or provide cross-owner revision coverage.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: Resources
sources.quality: Primary protocol specification; directly describes list/read, URI identity, pagination, and optional change notification capabilities.
observed: Discovery through resources/list and retrieval through resources/read are distinct operations; listing supports pagination.
Resource incorporation is application-driven rather than mandated by the protocol.
sources.application_inference: The list-then-exact-read seam is a useful mechanism example for progressive disclosure, provided CourtWork performs owner-scoped authorization and version checks at read time.
limits: The specification does not promise a complete cross-provider catalog, authorization policy, or consistent cross-owner snapshot.
It is not a recommendation to make MCP the internal storage or governance model.

sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
sources.quality: First-party practitioner account of Anthropic's own system and internal evaluation; high relevance to its implementation but self-reported, model-specific, and not independently replicated in the article.
observed: The report says separate context windows and parallel specialists helped breadth-first research in the company's internal evaluation.
It describes higher token use and failures including duplicate subtask work, gaps from vague instructions, excessive agent count, and weak fit for tasks with dependencies.
It recommends bounded objectives, output formats, source/tool guidance, task boundaries, and effort scaled to task complexity.
sources.application_inference: Parallelize independent discovery or review where the task value exceeds coordination cost; use bounded task/evidence packets and validate any claimed attention savings locally.
limits: The report's performance percentages are internal results and not a prediction for CourtWork.
It does not establish statistical independence, professional qualifications, or authority to accept formal work.

screened_not_used.title: CodeDelegator: Mitigating Context Pollution via Role Separation in Code-as-Action Agents
screened_not_used.reason: A primary research preprint appeared in the multi-agent query, but the retrieved excerpt did not include enough method, result, and limitation detail to support the governance or human-attention claims in this report.

research_limits: Only primary specifications, official control material, and first-party engineering evidence were retained for conclusions.
No product/library recommendation, benchmark performance claim, organization ACL design, or new product schema was selected.
All capability statements about CourtWork are based on the fixed local contracts and code listed in the companion exploration, not on external sources.
